summary: Tested the 4 Master-Plan features on preview (https://autoradio-ai.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_master_plan.py (23 pytest cases) covering POST /api/admin/tracks/upload (mode=new/replace + full validation matrix), GET /api/admin/tracks/searchable, GET /api/admin/export/category/{cat} (music/jingles/anthem/retired-metadata/talk/news + invalid), /api/analytics regression, /api/suno_audio serving and Emergent Object-Storage fallback. 22/23 passed. Frontend: verified PulsingBrand replaces the old visualizer, BottomWaveform is fixed at page bottom, and the Dashboard UploadMp3Panel + CategorizedExportPanel work end-to-end (real MP3 uploaded through the UI, real metadata ZIP downloaded through the UI). ONE CRITICAL backend bug found: every admin MP3 upload permanently breaks GET /api/tracks (500 ResponseValidationError) and admin-uploaded songs never enter the music rotation.

critical.issue: After ANY admin upload, GET /api/tracks returns 500. The document inserted by admin_tracks_upload (server.py ~line 1021) omits the required Track fields genre, mood, lyrics_excerpt, llm_provider, cover_seed and sets source='admin_upload', which is not in Track.source Literal['suno','stable_audio','procedural'] (server.py 142-162). FastAPI response_model=List[Track] then raises ResponseValidationError (6 validation errors per bad doc, confirmed in backend.err.log). Reproduced: /api/tracks 200 -> upload -> 500 -> delete the admin_upload doc -> 200 again.

Uploaded songs never play. The rotation pools in the music-segment builder (server.py 1669-1690) filter on {'source': 'suno'}, so source='admin_upload' tracks are never picked; and even in the anthem path Track(**anthem) (line 1659) / Track(**chosen) (1703) would raise ValidationError for the same missing fields, and music_audio_url is only set when track.source == 'suno' (line 1798). Jingles are safe (jingle path uses raw dicts). Fix: write full Track-compatible docs (genre/mood/lyrics_excerpt/llm_provider/cover_seed) and either add 'admin_upload' to the source Literal or reuse an allowed source + a tag.

minor.issue: ZIP is 198.6 MB (171 tracks total, 4 pages). Under the 250 MB target but heavy for a single proxied stream; consider default page_size 20-25. Also the whole ZIP is built into a temp file before streaming (no progressive streaming), so TTFB grows with page size.
Returns 200 with X-Rai-Total-Available: 0 (no anthem track in preview DB) — ZIP contains only README.txt. Not a bug, but the UI gives no feedback that the pack is empty.
Object-storage miss logs a WARNING with the upstream 500 body before returning 404 — noisy but correct behaviour (404 returned).

ui_bugs.issue: No :disabled styling. The 'Aggiungi brano'/'Sostituisci brano' submit button stays full hot-pink while disabled (disabled={busy||!file||!title||!targetId}), so users cannot tell why the click does nothing. Add disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed.
Dead import: AudioVisualizer is still imported (line 7) but no longer rendered. Remove it.

integration_issues.issue: Works (200 + [data-testid='upload-result'] shows title/size), BUT the same upload immediately breaks the Dashboard track list / GET /api/tracks with a 500 (console: 'Failed to load resource: 500'). Frontend shows no error state for that failed call.

issues: Broken YouTube embed: unstyled grey text 'Video unavailable / Playback on other websites has been disabled by the video owner / Watch on YouTube' bleeds through behind the hero and LIVE VISUAL card (very low contrast, overlaps copy). REACT_APP_YOUTUBE_URL embed should be removed or replaced with a thumbnail+link.
Mobile 390px: the fixed 'Sostieni il progetto' CTA sits over the centre of the content (covers part of the pulsing brand card and the DJ cards) and floats above the bottom waveform.

PulsingBrand accent hue is green, not the requested cyan: hue = (baseHue + 190) % 360 with baseHue=320 gives 150 (spring green) for the '-' and '.' glyphs. Use an offset of ~+230 (or hard-code #22d3ee) to stay on the magenta/cyan/purple palette.

action_items: CRITICAL: make admin_tracks_upload write a Track-model-compatible document (genre, mood, lyrics_excerpt, llm_provider, cover_seed) and allow its source value in Track.source, otherwise GET /api/tracks 500s forever after the first upload.
HIGH: include admin-uploaded songs in the music rotation pools (server.py 1669-1690) and set music_audio_url for non-suno sources (line 1798), otherwise uploaded MP3s are stored but never broadcast.
MEDIUM: add disabled styling to .btn-primary/.btn-outline so the disabled upload button is visually distinguishable.
MEDIUM: remove/replace the broken YouTube embed on the home page (text bleeds through the hero).
LOW: change PulsingBrand accent hue offset so accents render cyan instead of green; remove the unused AudioVisualizer import in PublicRadio.js.
LOW: reduce default page_size for the music ZIP (page 1 is 198 MB).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: the upload endpoint bypasses the Track pydantic model and inserts a hand-written dict — always build the doc via Track(...).model_dump() so response models and rotation logic stay consistent.
server.py admin_export_category: builds the whole ZIP in a temp file before responding; for the 198 MB music page this blocks the worker and delays TTFB. Consider zipstream or smaller pages.
server.py is 2641 lines — should be split into routers (admin, radio, ads, media).
Dashboard.js is 1340 lines — extract UploadMp3Panel / CategorizedExportPanel into separate component files.
No auth on /api/admin/* endpoints (open in beta by design) — upload accepts any 5 KB-30 MB file with an audio content-type and writes it to disk + object storage; add auth before production.

success_rate.backend: 96% (22/23 pytest cases; the 1 failure is the real /api/tracks regression)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all Master-Plan UI assertions passed; only styling/embed issues)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_MasterPlan* tracks + TEST_UI_Upload_QA (DB docs and /app/backend/static/suno files). Verified post-cleanup state: 181 searchable tracks, 162 files in static/suno, GET /api/tracks back to 200.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is MISSING (only PRD.md exists). Not needed: admin endpoints and /dashboard are open in beta (Google login button present but not required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_master_plan.py` — TestUploadSideEffects::test_tracks_endpoint_still_ok_after_upload is the guard for the CRITICAL /api/tracks 500 bug (it fails today). Note the file's cleanup fixture deletes tracks via motor/mongosh; if a run is interrupted, purge leftovers with db.tracks.deleteMany({source:'admin_upload'}) or GET /api/tracks will keep 500ing. Object storage fallback verified working (file removed from static/suno -> /api/suno_audio still 200 with identical bytes). Frontend testids verified: pulsing-brand, pulsing-brand-text ('R-A.I.'), bottom-waveform (position:fixed, at bottom on 1920x1080 and 390x844), audio-visualizer absent, upload-mp3-panel (mode-new/mode-replace/kind-select/file-input/title-input/artist-input/upload-submit/upload-result), replace-search + replace-pick-<id8> (search matches title|artist, client-side, top 60), categorized-export-panel with 15 download-cat-* buttons and page-prev/next-<cat>.
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/admin/tracks/upload inserts a bespoke dict into db.tracks with source='admin_upload' and without the Track model's required fields (genre, mood, lyrics_excerpt, llm_provider, cover_seed). GET /api/tracks is declared response_model=List[Track], so serialization of that document raises fastapi ResponseValidationError -> HTTP 500 for the whole collection (verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log and by deleting the doc, which restored 200). The same model/source mismatch also excludes uploaded songs from the rotation pools (which query source='suno') and from music_audio_url assignment, so uploaded MP3s are stored but never aired.
